text:
jo: Heads-up  Im doing a micro-refresh of the Hello quickstart to align snippets with SDK v8 and the new token name. Plan: rename env var, update JS/Py snippets, swap Dockerfile for a minimal multistage, and fix one broken link flagged by linkchecker.
ravi: Good. Which env var do we standardize on?
jo: REDWOOD_TOKEN. Will add a migration blurb for users still on REDWOOD_API_KEY.
ana: Can you paste the new snippets so I can run them in snippet-runner?
jo: JS snippet:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const resp = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello quickstart!' });
console.log(resp.output_text || resp.output[0].content);
```
Python snippet:
```py
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_TOKEN'))
out = client.text.generate(model='redwood-alpha', prompt='Hello quickstart!')
print(getattr(out, 'output_text', out.output[0].content))
```

mike: Ran locally  found one README bash block still referencing REDWOOD_API_KEY and a trailing comma in the python example that trips older interpreters. I can open a tiny PR to fix both against your branch.
jo: Please do. Also add a one-liner "Where to find your token" pointing to Console -> API keys and a .gitignore note to avoid baking tokens into images.
ravi: I'll review wording and the migration sentence once PR is up. Ping @ravi.
